draft_en.subject: Your SECON question - yes, we do OEM/ODM; the industrial PoE switch next to your data diodes
draft_en.body:
Dear Mr. Eki,

At SECON you asked whether we do OEM/ODM, and the mails you had from us since were general product mails rather than an answer - so, the answer: yes. For the industrial switch that sits next to your DD9000 / BIG9000 units, under the BlackBear label from small lots, -40 to 75 C, CE/RoHS: DIN-rail 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP, L2 managed, Marvell-based - model STI-288GPM - $85.5 USD EXW (MOQ 1, 15-day validity); the L2+ version with ring redundancy - STI-288DGGPM - $137.5; 802.3bt ports on request. Standard industrial units - no security-product claims. KC for the Korean channel stays on your side. Happy to continue in Chinese if easier.

One question: how many ports does the switch next to the diode need, and is 802.3bt power required?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
